name: rag-web-browser
title: RAG Web Browser - Search & Extract Web Content for LLMs
description: Web browser for AI agents, OpenAI Assistants API, and RAG pipelines. Queries Google Search, scrapes the top N pages, and returns clean Markdown, plain text, or HTML — ready for LLM processing. Supports chunked output for direct embedding into vector databases. Works as a tool in LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, and custom GPTs.
seoTitle: RAG Web Browser: Real-Time Web Search & Content Extraction for AI Agents & LLMs
seoDescription: Give your AI agent live web access. This Apify Actor searches Google, scrapes result pages, and returns clean Markdown with optional chunking — perfect for RAG pipelines, OpenAI Assistants, LangChain tools, and custom GPTs. Pay-per-event pricing starting at $0.002/query.
